answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for a 30-epoch horizon and is burned if the account is caught attesting junk. A farmer running 200 fake agents must keep all of them honest and funded through the whole window, so the payout never feels like an oasis, just a mirage of frozen coins. Like a juniper sapling, a real reputation only bears fruit after patient, verifiable growth.
